mintAuthority.summary: wM is an EIP-1967 minimal proxy (no admin slot, no UUPS) over WrappedMToken — wrap/unwrap is pure M-backed accounting with no privileged mint path. The contract's Migratable mechanism allows implementation changes, but only when a TTG-registered migrator key exists AND is called by migrationAdmin (a 2/2 Safe, v1.3.0, no modules). Base M issuance is inherited from reviewed m-m0 MinterGateway controls.

controls.label: WrappedMToken EIP-1967 proxy (Migratable)
controls.capDescription: EIP-1967 minimal proxy with no admin slot; upgrade requires TTG-registered migrator AND migrationAdmin (2/2 Safe) to call migrate(). vault()=0xd7298f620b0f752cf41bd818a16c756d9dcaa34f confirmed. Wrapper mints wM only by wrapping deposited M.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295240: EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x813b926b1d096e117721bd1eb017fba122302da0 (WrappedMToken, verified); no EIP-1967 admin slot (0x0); proxy code is a pure EIP-1967 minimal forwarder with no upgrade functions. migrationAdmin() selector 0x74df2558 returned 0x431169728d75bd02f4053435b87d15c8d1fb2c72; that address getOwners()=[0xdcf79c..., 0xe0c6ac...], threshold=2, masterCopy=0xd9db270c (v1.3.0), getModulesPaginated sentinel only (no modules), guard slot=0x0. vault()=0xd7298f... confirmed via 0xfbfa77cf. Migration additionally requires TTG Registrar key wm_migrator_v1 to be populated.

controls.label: Inherited M0 MinterGateway
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance inherited by wM depends on TTG-approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and collateral/debt checks.
controls.evidence: Inherited from reviewed m-m0 mintAuthority. 2026-07-20 (Kimi P2 dc-2): the MinterGateway (0xf7f9638cb444d65e5a40bf5ff98ebe4ff319f04e) exposes ttgRegistrar() = 0x119fbeedd4f4f4298fb59b720d5654442b81ae2c and minterRate() = 333 bps (both read 2026-07-20); minter caps/rates are set and can be raised by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is raiseable rather than fixed.
